milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/observe task. The potted lily of the valley is at spawn-relative (7, 1, 5) inside the east flower shop. Player must navigate into the building (doorway at z=2) and face the back shelf. Distance from spawn is ~8.6 blocks, well exceeding max_distance=4, so actual navigation is required.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/observe task. The smithing table is at spawn-relative (-7, 1, 3) inside the west blacksmith workshop. Distance from spawn is ~7.6 blocks, exceeding max_distance=4, requiring the player to enter the building through the doorway at (-7, z=2).

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/observe task. The lime wool is at spawn-relative (0, 1, 5) on the central corridor display stand. Distance from spawn is ~5.1 blocks, exceeding max_distance=4, so the player must walk north to observe it. Must be completed before mining gilded_blackstone (which removes its support block).

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/observe task. The black stained glass pane is at spawn-relative (-5, 2, 4) on the exterior east wall of the west blacksmith building. Distance from spawn is ~6.7 blocks, exceeding max_distance=5, requiring navigation toward the building. Target at y=2 requires looking slightly upward.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/observe task. The diorite stairs are at spawn-relative (0, 0, -5) marking the road start to the south. Distance from spawn is 5 blocks, exceeding max_distance=4. Player must walk south and face the stairs (requiring a 180-degree turn from default north-facing spawn).

Uses inventory_has because birch pressure plates drop themselves when mined by hand (no tool required). The pressure plate is on the flower shop floor at (7, 0, 4). Player starts with 0 birch pressure plates, so obtaining 1 confirms successful mining.

Uses count_in_box_at_most because blue stained glass panes drop NOTHING when broken without Silk Touch (player has no Silk Touch). Cannot use inventory_has. Instead verifies the block no longer exists at its location (-5, 1, 4) within a box encompassing the west building window area.

Uses count_in_box_at_most because gilded blackstone has a 10% chance to drop 2-5 gold nuggets INSTEAD of itself when mined with a pickaxe. Using inventory_has would have a 10% failure rate. Instead verifies the block is absent from a box around its location (0, 0, 5) in the road corridor. Iron pickaxe is provided to the player.

Uses count_in_box_at_least because building a road means placing path-like blocks on the ground. Checks for at least 5 cobblestone blocks in the central road corridor (x=-2 to 2, y=0, z=-4 to 7). Only cobblestone is provided in inventory (64 blocks), ensuring consistency. No cobblestone exists in this area initially (ground is grass_block at y=-1, air at y=0). 5 blocks represents a meaningful road segment.
